print.description:
Magnet base for RFID (NFC) Tags. Alternative to Coin Capsule.

Model is parametrizable via OpenSCAD for your favorite magnet and RFID Tag

  • No glue required, press fit for magnet, RFID tag and Lid works for me.
  • Can be used with Lid to protect the RFID tag and manget or with a round base figure.

STL file is parametrized for:

  • Magnet diameter = 9.8 mm
  • RFID Chip diameter = 25 m
